channel.title: GatorBait Media
channel.description: GatorBait Media is the premier source for Florida Gators news, founded by Emmy-winning journalist and NY Times best-selling author Buddy Martin. Covering UF athletics since 1979. Home of The Buddy Martin Show (LIVE Mon-Thu 9PM ET on YouTube and Facebook). In-depth reporting from Buddy Martin, Franz Beard, Carlton Reese, and the GatorBait team. Football, basketball, baseball, recruiting, transfer portal, gymnastics, softball, and every Gator sport. Photography by Chris Spears. Produced by Brenden Martin.

item.title: Rays the Roof! Have A Day Tampa Bay! Remembering St. Petersburg Before There Was MLB.
item.description: By Buddy Martin GatorBaitMedia.com As a former St. Petersburg resident and a sports columnist for the St. Petersburg Times who campaigned for major league baseball there back in the day — some 45 years ago — I have a confession and a hurrah. The confession: somewhere between covering the Gators and falling back in love with baseball, I became a Rays fan who watches 50, 60 games a year on TV whenever Florida isn't on. The hurrah: Friday night in Milwaukee, my Rays open the World Series — the...

item.title: Gators Stun No. 7 Texas 27-24 in Austin Behind Jones Jr.
item.description: AUSTIN, Texas — Florida walked into Darrell K Royal–Texas Memorial Stadium on Saturday with a backup quarterback making his first career start, fell behind 17-3, and walked out with the win of its season. The Gators (5-2, 3-2 SEC) scored 24 straight points and held on to beat No. 7 Texas 27-24, sealed late when Myles Graham sacked Arch Manning and knocked the ball loose, and Kanye Clark fell on it at the Texas 39. Tramell Jones Jr. got the start with Aaron Philo out and played every snap. His...

item.title: QB1 Philo Hurt. QB2 Jones To Start? Explained by That Great Football Mind Ted Lasso
item.description:
Buddy Martin called in the two greatest minds he knows, Albert Einstein and Ted Lasso, to explain Jon Sumrall's reverse thermostat, why calm is not surrender, and why Gator fans might not be crazy for believing. Members, the biscuits are inside.
Einstein had relativity. Ted Lasso has biscuits. And an amazing attitude. So does Tramell Jones.
item.dc:creator: Buddy Martin
